pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Frostspine Cave Bear is a massive beast whose back bears ridges of frozen bone. Adapted to the harshest cold, it inhabits snowy mountains and sheltered dens. Disturbing one in its territory is a dangerous mistake, even for experienced cultivators.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Found on snowy slopes, frozen and jagged peaks, groves, snowy taigas, ice spikes, and frozen rivers. Requires Y ≥ 72 or a covered sky.
